facts.statement: Patient endorsed active suicidal ideation with plan and intent at admission on 2026-11-01.

quotes.text: Endorses active suicidal ideation with plan and intent.

facts.statement: The patient stated a plan to overdose before admission, following a goodbye note written on October 31.

quotes.text: The patient stated a plan to overdose
wrote a goodbye note to a sibling

facts.statement: A preparatory act in the past week was documented on the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale at admission.

quotes.text: Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale positive for active ideation with plan and intent, and a preparatory act in the past week.

facts.statement: The 2026-11-01 progress note assessed the patient as high risk and stated continued need for inpatient level of care.

quotes.text: Continues to require inpatient level of care.

facts.statement: On 2026-11-01 the patient was on close observation.
Observation was reduced to every 15 minutes on November 2, as documented in the 2026-11-03 progress note.

quotes.text: Observation reduced to every 15 minutes on November 2.

facts.statement: On 2026-11-03 the patient reported passive suicidal ideation without plan or intent.

quotes.text: Patient reports passive suicidal ideation without plan or intent.

facts.statement: The 2026-11-03 progress note rated risk as moderate and cited the recent preparatory act, ambivalence about safety after discharge, and living alone.

quotes.text: Risk remains moderate given recent preparatory act, ambivalence about safety after discharge, and living alone.

facts.statement: On 2026-11-01 the patient was tearful and stated "I still want to die".
The patient was diagnosed with major depressive disorder, recurrent, severe, without psychotic features at admission.

quotes.text: Major depressive disorder, recurrent, severe, without psychotic features.

facts.statement: At admission the patient reported two weeks of worsening depressed mood after job loss.

quotes.text: Two weeks of worsening depressed mood after job loss

facts.statement: On 2026-11-03 the patient's mood was depressed with a slightly brighter affect and limited future orientation.
The 2026-11-03 progress note documented partial improvement.
The patient reported sleeping 3 to 4 hours a night before admission, and the 2026-11-01 note recorded 3 hours of sleep.
The patient had an 8-pound weight loss and poor appetite before admission.

quotes.text: poor appetite with an 8-pound weight loss

facts.statement: The patient ate 25% of meals on 2026-11-01 and 50% of meals on 2026-11-03.
The patient has a history of hypothyroidism, which is treated.
Urine drug screen was negative at admission.
At admission the patient was documented as disheveled with poor insight and judgment.
On 2026-11-03 the patient attended 2 of 4 groups.
Before admission the patient was nonadherent to sertraline for six weeks and outpatient therapy had stopped in July 2026.

quotes.text: Prescribed sertraline 100 mg; nonadherent for six weeks.
Outpatient therapy stopped in July 2026 after insurance change.

facts.statement: The patient had one prior inpatient admission in 2021 for suicidal ideation.

quotes.text: One prior inpatient admission in 2021 for suicidal ideation.

facts.statement: The patient lives alone in an apartment, and the sibling lives 40 minutes away.
A family meeting had not been held as of 2026-11-03 because the sibling was unavailable until November 4.

quotes.text: Family meeting not yet held; sibling unavailable until November 4.

facts.statement: The initial treatment plan listed the discharge plan as to be determined and an expected length of stay of 5 to 7 days.

quotes.text: Expected length of stay: 5 to 7 days.

gaps.why: The 2026-11-02 status, including the observation reduction referenced later, cannot be verified from a daily note for that day.

gaps.item: No documented discharge plan; the initial treatment plan says to be determined and the 2026-11-03 note only states to begin discharge planning
gaps.why: A reviewer cannot evaluate discharge criteria, step-down, or aftercare without a documented plan.

gaps.item: Initial treatment plan shows no signature, date of review, or update after 2026-11-01
gaps.why: A reviewer needs a signed and current treatment plan to confirm goals match the patient's status on 2026-11-03.

gaps.item: Sertraline dose discrepancy: intake lists prior prescription of 100 mg while the plan restarts at 50 mg and the 2026-11-03 note increases to 100 mg
gaps.why: The dose history should be clarified to support the medication plan and the reason for the change.

gaps.item: Concurrent review request for November 4 to 6 is marked as a draft and no submission or signature is documented; the approved authorization ends November 3
gaps.why: Continued-stay coverage depends on a submitted request before the stated deadline of November 3, 5:00 p.m. Eastern.

gaps.item: Family meeting and safety planning status not documented beyond the plan to hold it on November 4
gaps.why: Safety planning and family involvement were listed as interventions on 2026-11-01 and their completion is not recorded.
